description: Visual settings panel, status bar, live logs, egress IP and patch guard for Antigravity-Proxy (restores version.dll after IDE updates)
command.restartIde: Restart IDE to Apply Proxy Settings
config.language: Display language of the extension. "auto" follows the IDE display language.
config.autoRestore: After an IDE auto-update removes `version.dll` / `config.json`, restore them automatically at startup from the copy bundled with the extension (`config.json` is restored to your last saved settings first). Restart the IDE afterwards to apply.
config.statusBarEnabled: Show the proxy status in the status bar (click to open proxy settings).
config.probeInterval: Interval in seconds for the status bar proxy port check; 0 checks only at startup and after saving.
config.egressInterval: How often to refresh the proxy egress IP, in seconds (0 = manual refresh only; minimum 60 when enabled).
config.geminiInterval: How often to check Gemini/Antigravity availability, in seconds (0 disables the periodic check; minimum 60 when enabled).
config.updateEnabled: Check GitHub Releases for a newer version of this extension. Downloads are verified against SHA256SUMS.txt before install.
config.updateMode: What to do when a new version is found: notify only, or download and install automatically.
config.updateDelay: Delay before the first update check after startup, in seconds.
config.updateMirrors: GitHub mirrors tried before direct access. They must forward https://api.github.com (for example https://gh-proxy.com/).
